test_any_all: test the SQL ANY and ALL comparison operators against DataFrame columns
test_count: test SQL COUNT, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT), and COUNT(NULL) aggregation functions
test_cte_aliasing: test SQL CTE with nested table and column aliasing and LEFT JOIN
test_distinct: test SQL SELECT DISTINCT with expressions and context table unregistration
test_limit_offset: test SQL LIMIT and OFFSET pagination on LazyFrame data
test_nested_subquery_table_leakage: test that nested subquery derived table aliases do not leak into SQLContext
test_register_context: test nested SQLContext context manager table registration and cleanup
test_read_csv: test SQL read_csv function for reading CSV files into DataFrame results
test_select_explode_height_filter_order_: test SQL UNNEST with ORDER BY, WHERE filtering, and literal broadcasting
test_unsupported_select_clauses: test that ClickHouse PREWHERE, LATERAL VIEW, and Oracle hierarchical queries raise errors
